name: Elevate 'our Health
description: Elevate 'our Health is a proudly Surinamese wellness and health education service focused on pain relief, relaxation, physical well-being and healthy living. Our approach is personalized — health is not one-size-fits-all. We consider each person’s needs, lifestyle and well-being to create a more meaningful and tailored experience. As a professional massage therapist and Health Educator, we offer Relaxation, Deep Tissue, Sports, Bamboo and Waran Massage, as well as selected partial massages. Services are available by appointment, including mobile and home-based treatments. We also bring wellness to business events, family days, group activities and retreats, offering massage and health-focused experiences designed to help people relax, reconnect and recharge. At Elevate 'our Health, we believe health should be personal, practical and accessible — wherever people come together. HEALTH. BALANCE. ELEVATED.

name: Sana Budaya
description: Sana Budaya is a cultural and community centre of the Vereniging Herdenking Javaanse Immigratie (VHJI) in Suriname. The centre is dedicated to the preservation, promotion and transmission of Javanese and Surinamese cultural heritage. Sana Budaya provides a range of cultural, educational and community activities, including cultural events, performances, exhibitions, workshops, meetings and other public activities. The centre also provides facilities for cultural fairs, markets, sports and community gatherings. Located on the Sana Budaya premises are the Soeki Irodikromo Volksacademie voor Kunst en Cultuur (VAKC), which supports arts and cultural education, and V.H.J.I. Documentation Centre, which contributes to the preservation, documentation and accessibility of historical and cultural knowledge and materials related to Javanese heritage in Suriname.
